body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose up to two creatures within 1 unit. Compare this Action against each. On a success, deal 1 Slashing damage.

surges.html: Choose one creature damaged by this Action; apply Bleeding.
If you are Unstable, ignore Unstable's restriction until this Action finishes resolving.

rider.title: CHIMERA ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Many-Handed Form. While maintained: You may hold or manipulate two additional small objects and gain +1 Defense against Grapples.
